channel.title: The Clanton Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Clanton Advertiser (clantonadvertiser.com)

item.title: Tigers vying for eighth-straight Chilton County Softball Tournament crown
item.description: Chilton County High School seeks eighth-straight Chilton County Softball Tournament title as it hosts county rivals March 12-14 at its renovated stadium; see full pool and bracket schedule.

item.title: Column: Spring has sprung in Chilton County
item.description: Chilton County’s spring 2026 mixes a new courthouse, the Strawberry Festival and outdoor escapes from lakes and trails to local parks and ballparks.

item.title: Bail the Mayor — CareNet of Chilton County hosts unique fundraiser
item.description: Clanton mayor and other locals are ‘arrested’ in Care Net of Chilton County’s Bail for Babies fundraiser with donations still open.

item.title: What’s the Scoop? — The Chicken Scoop moves into downtown Clanton
item.description: Custom chicken salad hits downtown. The Chicken Scoop opens on Seventh Street North in Clanton with build-your-own scoops, homemade sides, rewards app and a 24-hour vending machine.

item.title: All That Glitters holds ribbon cutting
item.description: All That Glitters, a family-owned pageant, tux and formal dress shop in Clanton, marked its new storefront with a March 10 ribbon cutting.

item.title: Miller’s magic hands: Miller Chiropractic at The Well Spa can help the body function
item.description: At The Well Spa in Clanton, chiropractor Dr. Olivia Miller offers gentle, whole-body adjustments in a calming setting, drawing on a passion for helping all ages.

item.title: Revenge, dominating doubleheaders and new fields this week across Chilton softball
item.description: With the Chilton County softball tournament looming, Isabella avenges Horseshoe Bend, Verbena scores 43 in a doubleheader and CCHS wins two straight on its renovated field.

item.title: CCHS girls stay in good form as area play looms
item.description: CCHS girls soccer extends unbeaten streak to six and sets a new program record for single-season wins as area play approaches. Boys pick up win during week's play.

item.title: Hot bats, big strikeout games amongst week’s baseball action
item.description: Chilton County teams pile up strikeouts and runs as Maplesville outscored foes 58-1, Verbena’s Brothers combine for 14 RBIs and Thorsby arms rack up Ks in week's action.

item.title: Clanton Adient celebrates new launch with ribbon cutting
item.description: Clanton’s Adient plant marks launch of competitive new Nissan P42 program with ribbon cutting, celebrating local jobs, safety milestones and economic development for Chilton County.
